repo.name: Vorratsübersicht Sync
repo.description: Verteilte Datenbank-Synchronisation für Vorratsübersicht. LAN-Sync, Web UI, Off-Grid.

apps.description:
Keep track of your pantry items and their expiration dates.
Never throw away food because you forgot what's in your cupboard!

Features:
* Article management with categories, barcodes, and images
* Inventory tracking with quantities and best-before dates
* Expiry warnings and alerts
* Shopping list management
* Barcode scanning
* LAN sync: share data between multiple devices without internet
* Web interface: access your data from any browser
* Works off-grid: no internet connection required

This is a fork that adds distributed database synchronization
(LAN sync via REST API).
apps.summary: Monitor best-before dates of your food supplies
